answer: Every head must hold a whole relic to act, and a relic loses a third of itself each epoch, so each head buys a new one every epoch. The violet is the only seller and remembers every root it has sold to: the k-th relic of that root costs k sable, so a newcomer pays one sable an epoch, the owner of a thousand heads pays 500,500 sable an epoch, and the root's second head is charged two, not one.
